title: Mark complete resets at once; a lines-added service waits for the invoice
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with View and edit customers, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. A service is due or overdue on an enrolled asset (e.g. 'PM-A' on unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
custom_steps:
1. Mark complete a service and confirm it resets at once from the Reset date (both branches), never waiting for an invoice.
  2. On a service whose lines were added (not marked complete), confirm it waits for the work order's invoice.
  3. Confirm a fleet shop that never invoices keeps schedules current with Mark complete alone.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Mark complete resets the service at once from its Reset date, on either branch; it never waits for an invoice.
  • A service whose lines were added instead, and not marked complete, waits for its work order's invoice; until then its worklist row reads the work order's Complete status with its Invoice action.
  • A work order that is never invoiced never resets a service whose lines it added - the shop resets it with Mark complete; a fleet shop that never invoices keeps every schedule current with Mark complete alone.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10574 (S18, Complete a service and reset the cycle); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 1 / S18; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S18-R6: “Mark complete resets the service at once from its Reset date, on either branch. It never waits for an invoice. A service whose lines were added instead, and not marked complete, waits for its work order's invoice: until then its worklist row reads the work order's Complete status with its Invoice action, per S13-R26”
  • S18-N2: “A work order that is never invoiced never resets a service whose lines it added. The shop resets it with Mark complete, per S18-R1”
  • S18-E7: “A fleet shop that never invoices its own work orders keeps every schedule current with Mark complete alone”
